text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, addressed to you.

Your first report was your 10:42 AM post on 3 Aug, which said the gate kiosks were offline with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. The only thing the channel records about the guard in the meantime is that they were writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 AM post then says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Your 11:08 AM post confirmed both lanes were working as of 11:07.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: Ticket INC-4821 holds the status-page screenshot. Gideon's 11:08 AM post on 3 Aug says it's attached there, and that he was still chasing status-page access for Mateo's account. I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, addressed to you.
